CallProc.description:
A procedure call. `args` / `kwargs` (the project model, format 3): its positional and
keyword arguments. Left out of the IR's canonical JSON when empty, so every IR 2 flow keeps
its JSON and its hash; a PROJECT's canonical JSON always has them (`PROJECT_JSON` context).
CallProc.title: CallProc

CallV.description:
A FUNCTION's value (the project model, format 3: docs/planning/project-model.md section 2):
`x = pick(3, near=True)`. The function runs (its statements may act), then its `return` value
is the expression's value; no return (or `return` alone) is unknown (None).
CallV.title: CallV

Def.description: A function (`on` None) or an EVENT (a trigger: no inputs; its name is its event key).
Def.title: Def

Edge.description: The SESSION path (section 2.4): login -> character -> the start map node (its entry).
Edge.title: Edge

Param.description: A function's parameter: `default` None = required (the required ones come first).
Param.title: Param

Return.description:
`return` / `return value` (the project model, format 3): inside a function only (the
linter's `return_placement`); it ends the function, and a call used as a value gets `value`.
Return.title: Return

Trigger.description: An event's trigger: IR 2's Handler but its name and body (the def's).
Trigger.title: Trigger

ZonesRef.description:
The map node's zones (Amendment A 4, DRAFT; blocks-from-hunt-flow.md section 3): the file
`config/map_zones/<map>.yaml` stays the source of truth, the node names it by its sha256, so the
flow's hash covers the zones a person approved. The linter checks the file is there, unchanged
and the block's own map; a file for the block's map that the node does not name is an error.
ZonesRef.title: ZonesRef
